arxiv-2008-07588.title: Uncertainty Quantification using Variational Inference for Biomedical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2008-07588.creator: Abhinav Sagar
arxiv-2008-07588.description: Abstract Deep learning motivated by convolutional neural networks has been highly successful in a range of medical imaging problems like image classification, image segmentation, image synthesis etc. However for validation and interpretability, not only do we need the predictions made by the model but also how confident it is while making those predictions.

arxiv-2111-02791.title: A Cyber Threat Intelligence Sharing Scheme based on Federated Learning for Network Intrusion Detection
arxiv-2111-02791.creator: Mohanad Sarhan, Siamak Layeghy, Nour Moustafa, Marius Portmann
arxiv-2111-02791.description: Abstract The uses of Machine Learning (ML) technologies in the detection of network attacks have been proven to be effective when designed and evaluated in a single organisation. However, it has been very challenging to design an ML-based detection system by utilising heterogeneous network data samples originating from several sources.

arxiv-2205-15715.title: Carrier dynamics in quantum-dot tunnel-injection structures: microscopic theory and experiment
arxiv-2205-15715.creator: Michael Lorke, Igor Khanonkin, Stephan Michael, Johann Peter Reithmaier, Gadi Eisenstein, Frank Jahnke
arxiv-2205-15715.description: Abstract Tunneling-injection structures are incorporated in semiconductor lasers in order to overcome the fundamental dynamical limitation due to hot carrier injection by providing a carrier transport path from a cold carrier reservoir. The tunneling process itself depends on band alignment between quantum-dot levels and the injector quantum well, especially as in these devices LO-phonon scattering is dominant.

arxiv-2207-08931.title: Spinning Hexagons
arxiv-2207-08931.description: Abstract We reduce the computation of three point function of three spinning operators with arbitrary polarizations to a statistical mechanics problem via the hexagon formalism. The central building block of these correlation functions is the hexagon partition function . We explore its analytic structure and use it to generate perturbative data for spinning three point functions.

arxiv-2211-14135.title: Microscopic description of α \alpha , 2 ​ α 2\alpha , and cluster decays of 216-220 Rn and 220-224 Ra
arxiv-2211-14135.creator: J. Zhao, J.-P. Ebran, L. Heitz, E. Khan, F. Mercier, T. Nikšić, D. Vretenar
arxiv-2211-14135.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by J. Zhao, J.-P. Ebran, L. Heitz, E. Khan, F. Mercier, T. Nikšić, D. Vretenar. α \alpha and cluster decays are analyzed for heavy nuclei located above 208 Pb on the chart of nuclides: 216-220 Rn and 220-224 Ra, that are also candidates for observing the 2 ​ α 2\alpha decay mode. A microscopic theoretical approach based on relativistic Energy Density Functionals (EDF), is used to compute axially-symmetric deformation energy surfaces as functions of quadrupole, octupole and hexadecupole collective coordinates.

arxiv-2303-03346.title: Star-Image Centering with Deep Learning: HST/WFPC2 Images Journal: PASP Facilities: HST (WFPC2), MAST
arxiv-2303-03346.creator: Dana I. Casetti-Dinescu, Terrence M. Girard, Roberto Baena-Gallé, Max Martone, Kate Schwendemann
arxiv-2303-03346.description: Abstract A Deep Learning (DL) algorithm is built and tested for its ability to determine centers of star images on HST/WFPC2 exposures, in filters F555W and F814W. These archival observations hold great potential for proper-motion studies, but the undersampling in the camera’s detectors presents challenges for conventional centering algorithms.

arxiv-2405-16855.title: Maximal operators given by Fourier multipliers with dilation of fractional dimensions
arxiv-2405-16855.creator: Jin Bong Lee, Jinsol Seo
arxiv-2405-16855.description: Abstract . In this paper, we investigate L p L^{p} bounds of maximal Fourier multiplier operators with dilation of fractional dimensions. For the Fourier multipliers, we suggest a criterion related to dimensions of dilation sets which guarantees L p L^{p} bounds of the maximal operators for each p p .

arxiv-2407-20063.title: Temperature mediated back-action in micro- and nanomechanical resonators
arxiv-2407-20063.creator: L. Bellon, P. Verlot
arxiv-2407-20063.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the thermally induced back-action effects in absorption-sensitive micro- and nanomechanical resonators. We propose a unified approach, enabling to simultaneously address both the effective dynamics and non-equilibrium phononic state, depending on the position of a punctual sensing (and heating) probe at the surface of the mechanical device.

arxiv-2503-19699.title: Optimal Path Planning and Cost Minimization for a Drone Delivery System Via Model Predictive Control
arxiv-2503-19699.creator: Muhammad Al-Zafar Khan, Jamal Al-Karaki
arxiv-2503-19699.description: Abstract In this study, we formulate the drone delivery problem as a control problem and solve it using Model Predictive Control. Two experiments are performed: The first is on a less challenging grid world environment with lower dimensionality, and the second is with a higher dimensionality and added complexity.

pmc-10706551.title: Changes in the Impacts of COVID-19 over Time on Families with Older Adults Living on Remote Islands in Japan: A Study in Family Ethnographic Research
pmc-10706551.creator: Naohiro Hohashi, Mikio Watanabe, Minami Taniguchi, Shiho Araki, Francesco Cacciatore
pmc-10706551.description: Coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) affected not only individuals but also families. The purpose of this study was to clarify the temporal changes in the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on entire families with older adults susceptible to infection living on small islands in Japan over the duration of the pandemic.

pmc-11306028.title: Unlocking cellular traffic jams: olive oil-mediated rescue of CNG mutant channels
pmc-11306028.creator: Angeles Avalos-Hernandez, Karina Juarez-Navarro, Estela Ruiz-Baca, Ivan Meneses-Morales, Edith Espino-Saldaña, Ataulfo Martinez-Torres, Angelica Lopez-Rodriguez
pmc-11306028.description: One of the reasons to suggest olive oil consumption for a healthy life is its potential to induce robust lipidomic remodeling through membrane modification by dietary lipids. This remodeling might, in turn, modulate essential lipid-protein interactions while maintaining accurate transmembrane protein/domain orientation. Oleic acid, the primary compound in olive oil, has been suggested as a modulator of ion channel function.

pmc-11641040.title: Special Issue “Machine Learning and Bioinformatics in Human Health and Disease”—Chances and Challenges
pmc-11641040.creator: Andreas Leiherer
pmc-11641040.description: s and 1 review—that underscore the profound impact of computational methods on advancing precision medicine. Integrating advanced ML techniques with biological sciences, these works highlight applications ranging from disease prediction and biomarker discovery to therapeutic innovation and treatment optimization. Collectively, this research reflects the transformative potential of ML and bioinformatics in making healthcare more predictive, preventive, and personalized. 2.

pmc-11669961.title: Extended 72-hour patency capsule protocol improves functional patency rates in high-risk patients undergoing capsule endoscopy
pmc-11669961.creator: Fintan John O'Hara, Conor Costigan, Deirdre McNamara
pmc-11669961.description: BACKGROUNDCapsule endoscopy (CE) is a pivotal diagnostic tool for gastrointestinal (GI) disorders, yet capsule retention poses a significant risk, especially in patients with known risk factors. The patency capsule (PC) helps assess the functional patency of the GI tract to mitigate this risk.

pmc-11676402.title: Multimode Miniature Polarization-Sensitive Metamaterial Absorber with Ultra-Wide Bandwidth in the K Band
pmc-11676402.creator: Zhonghang Ji, Yida Song, Mandi Gao, Qiong Zhang, Yunqing Liu
pmc-11676402.description: Metamaterial absorbers have gained widespread applications in fields such as sensing, imaging, and electromagnetic cloaking due to their unique absorption characteristics. This paper presents the design and fabrication of a novel K-band polarization-sensitive metamaterial absorber, which operates in the frequency range of 20.76 to 24.

pmc-12435235.title: The molecular structure of the master growth regulator in plants emerges into the spotlight
pmc-12435235.creator: Hideki Yoshida, Makoto Matsuoka
pmc-12435235.description: bility (1). A well-known molecular activity of DELLAs is to regulate transcription through physical interaction with transcription factors: This can interfere with the factors’ ability to bind to gene promoters, or they can directly activate transcription by acting as coactivators in partnership with transcription factors (2).

pmc-12737654.title: Early Detection of Porcine Reproductive and Respiratory Syndrome Virus Outbreak: Combination of Methods
pmc-12737654.creator: Cunshuai Gao, Yunzhou Wang, Mengmeng Liu, Haotian Yang, Wenjing Jiao, Xuanpan Ding, Yuan Zhao, Honggang Fan
pmc-12737654.description: Simple SummaryPorcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) has spread globally and has caused substantial economic losses in the swine industry. The use of the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) analysis of production parameters for the early detection of PRRSV outbreaks is a practical approach.

pmc-13063633.title: A mixed-methods study on speech and language disorders after the earthquake in Türkiye: awareness, service gaps, and lived experiences
pmc-13063633.creator: Agit Şimşek, Tuba Kaya
pmc-13063633.description: ObjectiveThis study examines societal awareness levels, service access barriers, and policy gaps regarding speech and language disorders (SLD) after the February 6, 2023 Kahramanmaraş earthquakes, utilizing a mixed-methods approach.MethodsAn explanatory sequential mixed-methods design was employed. A quantitative survey was conducted with 450 participants via stratified cluster sampling across four severely affected provinces.

pmc-13248746.title: Engineering hierarchical porosity in MOFs for host–guest chemistry with large organometallic complexes
pmc-13248746.creator: Jakob Blaschke, Maria Asghar, Zheao Huang, Stephen Nagaraju Myakala, Shaghayegh Naghdi, Thomas Schachinger, Hanspeter Kählig, Olga Lanaridi, Andreas Limbeck, Jérôme Durand, Philippe Serp, Florian Libisch, Dogukan H. Apaydin, Dominik Eder
pmc-13248746.description: The microporous nature of metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) often limits their capacity to incorporate large molecular guests, such as organometallic catalysts. In this work, we demonstrate a defect-engineering strategy for the Zr-based MOF UiO-66 to generate hierarchical pore structures capable of hosting the bulky Lehn-type complex [Re(bpy-4-COOH)(CO)3Cl].

pmc-13339103.title: Ultrafast Optoacoustics Reveals Intricate 3D Anisotropic Elasticity in Nanocrystalline Membranes
pmc-13339103.creator: Shuchang Zhang, Yi He, Guojie Luo, Jie Huang, Pak San Yip, Haoyu Cui, Wanglinhan Zhang, Zijian Wang, Lin Ye, Yang Lu, Zhongqing Su, Yehai Li
pmc-13339103.description: The mechanical performance of nanocrystalline membranes plays a critical role in determining the reliability and stability of advanced integrated circuit devices and nano‐electromechanical systems. Conventional characterization techniques such as nano‐indentation and micro‐scale mechanical testing, while widely used, are generally destructive and incapable of resolving three‐dimensional (3D) anisotropic properties.

pmc-13355637.title: Validity of the Khamis-Roche method, relative to bone age, in Portuguese children and adolescents from 11 to 15 years
pmc-13355637.creator: Isabel Fragoso, Joao Albuquerque, Júlia Teles, Fabiana Bonito, Luís Miguel Massuça, Fernando Paiva Moura, Carlos Barrigas, Luis Alberto Flores
pmc-13355637.description: Objectiveto validate maturity status classification, based on %PAH, relative to SA, in a sample of Portuguese children and adolescents of both sexes.MethodsBA was measured by the Tanner-Whitehouse-3 method, the PAH and %PAH were estimated by the Tanner-Whitehouse-3 method (BA- PAH, % BA-PAH) and the Khamis-Roche method (KR- PAH, %KR- PAH) in 371 children (171 girls).

pmc-13367830.title: The emergence of human influence on the ozone layer by the 1960s
pmc-13367830.creator: Jian Guan, Benjamin D. Santer, Peidong Wang, Qiang Fu, Rolando R. Garcia, Yaowei Li, Kane Stone, Douglas E. Kinnison, Jun Zhang, Gabriel Chiodo, Jean-Francois Lamarque, Susan Solomon
pmc-13367830.description: SignificanceThis paper examines the earliest emergence of human-caused ozone depletion: the when, the where, and the why. We employ a thought-experiment framework aimed at the physical emergence of the signal in a hypothetical world in which instruments had the same capabilities as today’s satellites.

pmc-13388468.title: ShuffleNetV2 SSM MLCA: a lightweight recognition network for wheat fungal diseases
pmc-13388468.creator: Yuxin Shi, Cheng Zeng, Nan Chi
pmc-13388468.description: IntroductionWheat is one of the most widely planted staple crops worldwide and underpins global food security. Fungal diseases severely threaten wheat growth and trigger massive yield losses during cultivation. Traditional manual diagnosis is time-consuming and highly subjective, while existing deep learning models often struggle to achieve high accuracy and robustness in complex field environments.

pmc-13471353.title: Analysis of the effect of variable frequency fan on tobacco metabolites during curing via untargeted metabolomics
pmc-13471353.creator: Di Shi, Xiaoqiang Zhang, Guanhui Li, Hongfeng Liu, Zhengfa Shi, Jiawei Luo, Xin Jin, Shengjiang Wu, Ning Huang, ZeYu Zhao, Lingli Xie, Kesu Wei
pmc-13471353.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The Variable-frequency (VF) fan regulation is a promising technique for flue-curing of tobacco (Nicotiana tabacum L.), and exploring its mechanism is of great significance for improving the curing quality. The middle leaves of “Yunyan 87” were used as experimental materials for exploring the changes of metabolic components by untargeted metabolomics and monitoring dynamic changes of key physiological indicators during flue-curing, VF curing (dynamic frequency: 35–40–45–40 Hz) and constant-frequency curing (50 Hz, CK).
